test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - Quant (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A sector having a radius of 9 cm and has a central angle of 60°. What is the area of the sector?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Angle 60° is exactly 1/6th of a full 360° circle.

Area of a full circle with radius 9 cm = π × 9² = 81π cm².

Area of the sector = (1/6) × 81π = 13.5π cm².

In fractional form, 13.5π = 27π/2 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 27π/2 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 9 cm

Central Angle (θ) = 60°

**Formula Used:**

Area of a Sector = (θ / 360°) × πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fc2f280b06eff22b45b39cab6adf7fc4617ac1d58fd5b186efd0986b07b974c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (60 / 360) × π × (9)²

⇒ Area = (1 / 6) × π × 81

⇒ Area = 81π / 6

⇒ Area = 27π / 2 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 27π/2 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Length of an Arc

The length of the curved boundary of a sector is given by L = (θ/360) × 2πr.

Perimeter of a Sector

The total boundary of a sector includes the arc length plus two radii: Perimeter = L + 2r.

Area in terms of Arc Length

If the arc length (L) is known, the area can also be calculated as Area = (1/2) × L × r.

Area of Segment

The area of a segment of a circle is calculated as Area of Sector − Area of the Triangle formed by the chord.
